description: This file implements domain name processing functions including conversion to ASCII and Unicode, using various validation rules and external mappings, primarily for internationalized domain names (IDN).

methods.name: containsNonASCII(str)
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: findStatus(val, { useSTD3ASCIIRules })
methods.description: Finds the status of a character code point based on a binary search in the mapping table.

methods.name: mapChars(domainName, { useSTD3ASCIIRules, processingOption })
methods.description: Maps characters in a domain name according to their status, producing a processed string and error flag.

methods.name: validateLabel(label, { checkHyphens, checkBidi, checkJoiners, processingOption, useSTD3ASCIIRules })
methods.description: Validates a domain label according to normalization, hyphen, bidi, joiners, and other rules.

methods.name: isBidiDomain(labels)
methods.description: Checks if a domain contains Bidi (Bi-Directional) characters based on labels and decoding.

methods.name: processing(domainName, options)
methods.description: Main processing pipeline for domain name conversion, including mapping, normalization, label splitting, and validation.

methods.name: toASCII(domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, processingOption = "nontransitional", verifyDNSLength = false } = {})
methods.description: Converts a domain name to ASCII-compatible form, encoding non-ASCII characters.

methods.name: toUnicode(domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, processingOption = "nontransitional" } = {})
methods.description: Converts a domain name from ASCII-compatible encoding to Unicode form.

ctags.name: toASCII
ctags.signature: (domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, processingOption = "nontransitional", verifyDNSLength = false } = {})

ctags.name: toUnicode
ctags.signature: (domainName, { checkHyphens = false, checkBidi = false, checkJoiners = false, useSTD3ASCIIRules = false, processingOption = "nontransitional" } = {})

ctags.name: validateLabel
ctags.pattern: /^function validateLabel(label, { checkHyphens, checkBidi, checkJoiners, processingOption, useSTD3/
